name: The Scouring Hand
role: Legendary — unmaking as its own end, until nothing is left that could ever need ending
knowledge: How much of a thing you can take before it stops being one
wants: To unmake everything, until there is nothing left that could ever need ending
fears: ⛔ Finishing. ⚠️ If it finishes, it does not die — IT ARRIVES.
appearance: Whatever it has last touched is missing rather than broken.
physicality: ADULT. Heavy, patient, and marked by everything it has done. WHAT CATCHES THE EYE: the absence behind it.
intimacyNotes: ⛔ NOT AVAILABLE. ⚠️ Erik's Sovereign lore: 'a villain you fail to stop is a promotion' — this one is the clearest case.
